text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...I tried my hardest to incorporate the new theory into the training menu, but...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Tsk.
I'm so sleepy my brain won't work...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped... I'll just crash for tonight.
I can look over the materials again after—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait.
If it's the one they brought before—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... that pup came up with
a pretty interesting idea.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Taking this as a base and adding my own insights...
...Right, the key is where, how much, and in what order fatigue builds up. In that case, the slope course should be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after refining the training plan
until everyone was satisfied...
we ended up staying up late.
